statement.text: Start a new Brain. My old Brain stays erased. Only information I add or approve from now on can enter the new one.

proved: one versioned plain-language statement has a pinned content fingerprint
a missing or invalid authenticated user fails before any scope resolution or reservation
the browser request has an exact five-field shape and cannot submit subject, custody, operator, consent or new-scope identities
subject consent attribution is derived only from the authenticated user
stable subject, previous custody and operator identities are derived through the server resolver
consent, new workspace and new custody identities are generated server-side
the request fingerprint binds authenticated user, old workspace, decision, statement version and statement content
an unavailable scope returns one bounded response without revealing whether the old workspace exists
reservation failure does not expose database detail
a downstream response that claims scope creation is rejected
the successful response exposes only receipt identity and reserved-not-created standing

claim_boundary.human_action: A future Edge Function must authenticate the bearer token and invoke this logic from an explicit subject action. This dormant module proves the binding logic, not that a person has acted.
claim_boundary.scope: The logic calls only the R36 reservation contract and rejects any result that claims the new scope already exists.
claim_boundary.runtime: No Edge Function entrypoint imports this module. No endpoint, migration, database object or deployment is created.

next_gate: Specify and prove the atomic new-scope creator against an accepted R36 reservation, including personal-workspace owner semantics and exactly-once replay.
not_authorized: claiming cognitive understanding from an authenticated action
creating an Edge Function entrypoint or application caller
creating or activating a new Brain scope
